item.title: U.S. drafts plan to end war with Iran as 2,000 paratroopers are ordered to deploy in the Middle East
item.summary: Nearly a month into the war with Iran, the Trump administration is keeping its options open: it has drafted a 15-point plan to end the war with Iran and ordering thousands of paratroopers to deploy in the Middle East.

item.title: How Trump's Iran war objectives have shifted over time
item.summary: Here is a reminder of some of what he has said - and where the US is now.

item.title: Rubio plans travel to France to sell Iran war to skeptical G7 allies
item.summary: Secretary of State Marco Rubio will travel to France this week to try to sell America's skeptical Group of Seven allies on the Iran war that has sent global fuel prices soaring.

item.title: Your data is everywhere. The government is buying it without a warrant
item.summary: Data brokers buy up huge amounts of information from cell phones and browsers to sell for targeted advertising. But the government, including ICE, also buys the data.

item.title: They gave her business a lifeline, then froze all her money
item.summary: A murky corner of the financial world is now the fastest-growing source of funding for small businesses. One state, Connecticut, had given these lenders unusual power. That may be about to change.

item.title: A shelter village provides a bridge to permanent housing
item.summary: Shelter villages offer temporary and private places for the unhoused to sleep and store belongings. One of the newest, The Bridge, opened recently in central Illinois.

item.title: Judge says government's Anthropic ban looks like punishment
item.summary: Tech company Anthropic, the maker of the Claude AI system, is suing the Trump administration over the government labeling it a "supply chain risk."

item.title: Are you sure you know what 'gaslighting' is?
item.summary: Therapists say we're overusing the word. Here's what it actually means — and what the Ingrid Bergman film that helped birth the word can teach us about it.

item.title: Mumford & Sons: Tiny Desk Concert
item.summary: The British folk-rock band shares world-weary anthems to growing older, weathering the innumerable blows of life and coming out on the other side, hopefully a little wiser.

item.title: OpenAI pulls the plug on Sora, the viral AI video app that sparked deepfake concerns
item.summary: OpenAI said Tuesday that it was "saying goodbye to the Sora app" and that it would share more soon about how to preserve what users already created on the app.
